# Mayura Garden Services

> Pre-sale garden styling and landscaping in Melbourne — helping homes sell faster and for more.

Mayura Garden Services is a Lower Templestowe-based landscaping business specialising in pre-sale garden styling, planting, mulching, lawn care, hedge trimming and clean-ups across Melbourne, Victoria.
